supersededNote: Historical measurement only; use the superseding report for current figures.

basis.rule: Explains why member coverage does not imply property-rule validation coverage. Current validation only applies scalar/tuple properties when the vector has one attributable target member and a series output.

interpretation.dominantFilter: Most property rules are not scalar plot-series rules, and most scalar rules that do appear in vectors are in multi-target cases without output-to-member attribution.
interpretation.costToRaiseCoverage: Raising coverage safely needs per-output member attribution on existing multi-target vectors and payload-aware validators for collection, enum, string, color, handle and side-effect rules. That is manual provenance/validator work, not a small switch and not a reason to write hundreds of new vectors tonight.
